added_findings.title: Flask drawing-notes GET re-serialises with sorted keys
added_findings.detail: WCP/server.py:803-804 answers GET with jsonify(json.load(f)). The bundled Flask is 3.0.0, whose DefaultJSONProvider.sort_keys is True (flask/json/provider.py:151), and server.py does not override it, so every object comes back with alphabetically sorted keys. Spec Normalise rebuilds the schema keys in a fixed order but appends non-schema keys in source order (VV Document :175, :184), and LockJson compares the result as a string (TV Document :256-268). A group or note carrying two or more non-schema keys would therefore read back differently from what the app wrote, and the lockstep would ask about a file that did not move. Latent today: none of the four VV project notes files carries a non-schema key.
added_findings.recommendation: In WP-S06b-02 serve GET with send_from_directory (bytes as stored, conditional: Last-Modified and ETag free) instead of jsonify; keep 404 {missing:true}.
added_findings.evidence: WCP/server.py:803-804; Whitecardopedia/src/ThirdParty__VersionLockedDependencies/SERVER__FlaskServerDepencies/flask-3.0.0.dist-info, flask/json/provider.py:151; VV SpecData__Document__.js:175, :184; scan of the four ValeVision__DrawingNotes__.json files

notes: The survey was strong on facts: every 'VV lacks' claim held when searched across all of VVM; every TV version and devlog citation checked out (v2.104, v2.143, v2.144, v2.147, v2.148, v2.163 read in full); both live VV data-safety faults are real (Transport :324 unconditional RestoreDraft; :478 Reload Local adopts the file as the cloud copy while the Sync button stays disabled on !dirty); the drift table's 'header-only' rows for Draft and Editing are wrong as stated. Its weaknesses were at the planning level. (1) Floor Areas 'last' and the Region tool 'after the hub' are impossible: TV's SheetTools hub, Measurements, ContextMenu and MarkupBridge statically import FloorAreas__Tool/__Menu/__Paint and NoteRegions__Tool, and S05a/S03b port those files whole - split WP-07 and WP-10 into early inert modules (07a, 10a) and late UI (07b, 10b). (2) Roughly a dozen files, several tests and six decisions are scheduled by S06b and by S03b/S03a/S05a/S05b/S06a/S07b/S08 - the planner must pick one owner per file; WP-S06b-11 and WP-S06b-12 are outright duplicates (refuted). (3) VV is cached by Whitecardopedia's service worker (token '2026-09-18-1'), which no package footer bumps. (4) S09's CfApi/LocalMirror shim plan competes with this slice's R2DrawingNotes adaptation (D-S06b-V01). Minor slips corrected: VV History is 1.4.0; 8 stale TV headers not 9 (plus plan row U); the AreaSchedule config is a 56-key block, not 64 keys; WordBar/Field carry TrueVision strings; VV does not vendor jsPDF 4.1.0.
